Tumore renale a cellule chiare papillare: Clear cell papillary renal tumor (formerly clear cell papillary carcinoma) of about 6 cm, left kidney (KiTS-00200)
Uomo di 75 anni con massa renale sinistr: 75-year-old man with a left renal mass. Kidney CT without contrast, in contrast phase and in delayed excretory phase.

Davanti a una massa renale solida la TC:
In front of a solid renal mass, multiphase CT serves to: exclude macroscopic fat (angiomyolipoma) in the unenhanced phase; demonstrate enhancement (increase > 20 HU compared with unenhanced); assess the relationship with the renal sinus and the collecting system (delayed phase); stage (renal vein and cava, lymph nodes, adrenal gland, metastases).
T stage: T1a ≤ 4 cm, T1b 4-7 cm, T2 > 7 cm limited to the kidney; T3a invasion of perirenal fat or sinus or renal vein; T3b-c cava.
Histology: clear cell papillary renal tumor (WHO 2022, formerly "clear cell papillary carcinoma") is indolent and almost never metastasizes; on CT it cannot be distinguished from other solid tumors. The report must give size, location, relationships and stage, not the histology.
Massa renale: grasso? impregnazione > 20: Renal mass: fat? enhancement > 20 HU? sinus, veins, lymph nodes: the T stage guides surgery.
Tumore renale a cellule chiare papillare: Clear cell papillary renal tumor (clear cell papillary RCC, ISUP 2), pT1b N0 M0; open radical nephrectomy (data from the C4KC-KiTS collection).
Massa del polo superiore e interpolare d: Mass of the upper and interpolar portion of the left kidney
Massa renale già nota al richiedente, se: Renal mass already known to the requesting physician, without acute complications: the report is enough.
Massa solida del rene sinistro, del polo: Solid mass of the left kidney, of the upper pole and interpolar portion, of about 5.5-6 cm, with heterogeneous enhancement and a large, less enhancing central area
Segmentazione della collezione: circa 92: Collection segmentation: about 92 mL; radiologic diameter 5.7 cm.
La massa raggiunge il seno renale e defo: The mass reaches the renal sinus and deforms the collecting system, which opacifies in the delayed phase without filling defects
Vena renale e vena cava inferiore pervie: Renal vein and inferior vena cava patent, without thrombus; no evident retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy
Lesioni rotonde a densità liquida, senza: Round fluid-density lesions without enhancement at the lower pole of the left kidney and in the right kidney (the larger one exophytic at the right lower pole): simple cysts
Polo inferiore sinistro circa 5 HU senza: Left lower pole about 5 HU without contrast, 11 HU in contrast phase, 16 HU in delayed phase: no significant enhancement. They should not be confused with the mass, which lies higher up.
Nella fase senza mezzo di contrasto non: In the phase without contrast there are no areas below −10 HU.
The lesion is solid and enhances.
Trombo tumorale nella vena renale sinist: Tumor thrombus in the left renal vein
Massa solida del polo superiore e interp: Solid mass of the upper and interpolar portion of the left kidney of about 6 cm (cT1b), without venous invasion: nephrectomy (radical or partial depending on location and function); the nature is given by histology
La TC non distingue con certezza oncocit: CT cannot reliably distinguish oncocytoma from carcinoma (the "central scar" is not specific).
Massa cT3a per invasione della vena rena: cT3a mass due to renal vein invasion
Grasso macroscopico nella lesione (densi: Macroscopic fat in the lesion (negative density on the unenhanced scan), as from an angiomyolipoma
La massa del polo superiore è una cisti: The upper-pole mass is a simple cyst (Bosniak I), without enhancement
Trombo tumorale che si impregna nella ve: Enhancing tumour thrombus in the left renal vein, extending to the junction with the cava
Oncocitoma certo per l'area centrale men: Certain oncocytoma because of the less-enhancing central area resembling a scar: benign lesion, no treatment or follow-up
Pielonefrite focale (nefrite batterica): Focal pyelonephritis (bacterial nephritis) of the upper pole: antibiotic therapy and follow-up CT after a few weeks
Massa renale cT3a per invasione della ve: Renal mass cT3a because of left renal vein invasion with tumour thrombus: radical nephrectomy with thrombectomy
Oncocitoma certo per l'area centrale men: Certain oncocytoma because of the less-enhancing central area resembling a stellate scar and the sharp margins: benign lesion, no treatment or radiological follow-up
Massa renale sinistra cT3a per invasione: Left renal mass cT3a because of renal vein invasion with tumour thrombus extending to the cava: radical nephrectomy with caval thrombectomy
Oncocitoma certo per l'area centrale men: Certain oncocytoma because of the less-enhancing central area resembling a stellate scar, the sharp margins and the absence of venous invasion: benign lesion, no treatment or radiological follow-up
